tests.contains: describe('Vercel real-factory lifecycle contract (native SDK boundary)', () => {

claims: Named native-only-mocked tests reject missing, null or malformed foreground exit status, preserve valid integer statuses and exact captured text, and acknowledge only explicit detached null as launched rather than completed.
Named tests preserve ordinary native-error handling and timeout forwarding without replaying the command.

Named lifecycle regressions map genuine native sandbox APIError404 only, validate matching native names, permanently delete instead of stop, await void deletion, and retain orphan snapshots/drives through manager and instance paths.
limitations: Only named local command and lifecycle regression cases are covered; live native behavior, other operations and full capability coverage remain unverified.
No clean dependency installation or native-provider execution was performed; the existing installed dependency store was reused.
Installed native SDK contracts were inspected at the recorded version; compatibility throughout the declared dependency range is unverified.
Ordinary native errors retain the existing synthetic exit127 policy; protocol rejection does not itself guarantee remote cleanup or process-tree reaping.
The native SDK itself masks some missing finished wire exit status to zero; adapter-boundary checks cannot recover that omission.
Detached exit0 is an explicit launch acknowledgement only, not proof of child completion or complete streams.

Permanent native delete and later SDK-null verification have not run live. Orphan snapshots and separately owned drives are deliberately retained and may keep storage charges; no all-artifact/billing cleanup claim.
command: pnpm --filter @computesdk/vercel --fail-if-no-match exec vitest run src/__tests__/command-contract.test.ts src/__tests__/lifecycle-contract.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1
scope: Historical revision-specific local regression evidence, not all-capability or current/future-tree native certification.
